must_have.requirement: 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including experience owning SaaS, growth, or commercially successful software products.
must_have.evidence_summary: 6+ years in formal PM/SPM titles (Byju's July 2020–April 2023, Lowe's India Sep 2024–Present) plus Founder of Hype (2023–2024) and earlier product roles at Byju's (2015–2020), owning high-scale growth, SaaS consulting, and enterprise software platforms.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly meets 5+ years PM and growth/software ownership requirement.

must_have.requirement: Define and execute product growth strategy across acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion.
must_have.evidence_summary: Led growth and funnel strategy at Byju's (generating 2.5L+ SQLs and improving lead conversion by 35%, plus +5% course completion on Tynker), Hype (+50% engagement, +30% traffic, 80%+ completion), and HealthQ Rehab (+35% organic traffic, +20% brand engagement).
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly highlight full-funnel growth ownership spanning acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention.

must_have.requirement: Demonstrated ability to formulate, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps in partnership with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer teams.
must_have.evidence_summary: Defined and executed product roadmaps across engineering, design, marketing, finance, and operations teams at Lowe's India and Byju's.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly supported across both enterprise platform and growth product roles.

must_have.requirement: Strong analytical skills and experience using qualitative and quantitative data and rapid, iterative experimentation to guide product decisions.
must_have.evidence_summary: Led product experimentation, funnel friction analysis, and KPI framework design across Byju's (12 cross-product prototypes, 35% conversion lift, 5% completion lift) and Lowe's India.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly emphasize hypothesis-driven experimentation and KPI-led prioritization.

must_have.requirement: Deep customer empathy and ability to translate complex customer problems into simple, compelling product experiences.
must_have.evidence_summary: Simplified complex operational workflows for store setup teams at Lowe's (20% cycle time reduction) and redesigned instructor/learner workflows at WhiteHat Jr. (15% reduction in instructor training time) and Tynker (+5% completion).
must_have.positioning_bridge: Highlight workflow simplification for both operational teams and end users.

preferred.requirement: Experience scaling products that serve physical operations, workforce management, fleet/equipment operations, or enterprise operational teams.
preferred.evidence_summary: At Lowe's India, built and scaled an enterprise asset lifecycle platform ($2M annual cost savings) and an AI-driven procurement and catalog system that reduced operational cycle times by 20% for physical store setup teams.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Strong adjacent bridge from Lowe's physical store setup operations and enterprise asset lifecycle management to Motive's physical operations and workforce management context.

implicit.requirement: Lead customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to identify high-value growth opportunities.
implicit.evidence_summary: Conducted funnel friction analysis, audience demand alignment, and GTM opportunity discovery across Byju's, Hype, and HealthQ Rehab.
implicit.positioning_bridge: Directly supported by GTM and growth discovery track record.

domain.requirement: B2B SaaS Product-Led Growth & Physical Operations / Workforce Management.
domain.evidence_summary: Combines direct Product-Led Growth and funnel optimization expertise (Byju's, Hype) with physical retail store setup and enterprise asset operations experience (Lowe's India), though without prior fleet/telematics WFM software ownership.
domain.positioning_bridge: Synthesize PLG/funnel conversion mastery with Lowe's physical operations & asset lifecycle experience.
